verdict.rationale: GA4's Measurement Protocol docs refer to devices and apps 'where automatic collection is not available'. That implies GA4 has its own automatic event collection once the Google Analytics code is added to a site. The pack never says what that collection captures, so automatic clicks and form interactions are unevidenced; only page_view as an event is mentioned, and only by a community member. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of automatic or enhanced measurement covering pageviews, outbound or link clicks, and form interactions; configuration details; independent hands-on confirmation that autocapture works without per-event code.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can capture clicks, pageviews, and form interactions automatically without writing tracking code for each event
